canonical_project: Varanasi data centre park (Uttar Pradesh 8-park programme)
owner: Government of Uttar Pradesh / private investors TBD
notes: ETDatacenters (9 Apr 2026) reports UP plans eight data centre parks (Noida, Greater Noida, Yamuna Expressway region, Ghaziabad, Lucknow, Kanpur, Varanasi, Agra) targeting Rs 2 lakh crore investment and 900 MW; for Kanpur, Varanasi and Agra, site identification and master-plan preparation are still in progress. The 23 Jun 2026 report also lists Varanasi among locations receiving approved investment proposals (state pipeline of 644 MW committed). No Varanasi-specific site, developer or MW published yet.
